description:
Implement `OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic`:
- Request builder: convert `%OctoPi.AI.Context{}` to Anthropic's Messages API payload (messages, tools, system prompt, cache markers).
- Tool-call ID normalization (Anthropic regex `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$`).
- Response parser: consume SSE events, map to canonical `OctoPi.AI.Event` structs.
- API key: env var lookup (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`).

Behaviour impl. Tests via a recorded fixture + live smoke test gated on env.
title: Anthropic provider implementation
